messages:
Harper: quick heads-up — I'm landing a docs PR to align the streaming+retry examples across py/ts/go. trying to avoid breaking examples during the SDK v2->v3 migration.
Nina: thanks! do you have the PR link? want to skim the python generator pattern first.
Harper: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4591 — main change is switching to the new streaming iterator + explicit retry/backoff helper.
docs-bot: New pull request opened: redwood-inference/docs#4591 by Harper — title: 'sdk: harmonize streaming retry/paginate examples (py/ts/go)'.
Tom: skimmed. TS looks good, but the Go snippet still uses the old channel-based stream pattern; we should show the idiomatic ctx/cancel + for loop with `Recv()` to match go-sdk v3.
Harper: good call. I left a TODO in the PR to replace the Go example with the `for { resp, err := stream.Recv() }` pattern and a short cancel example.
Rajat: can we keep parallel examples for both `auto-retry` and `manual backoff`? product folks sometimes want the explicit backoff to explain observable retries.
Nina: prefer to show recommended approach first (auto-retry via client config) and then a tiny snippet for manual backoff. keep both under 10-12 lines each.
Maya: also noticed the pagination snippet still references `next_cursor` field (old API). The SDK now exposes a `list.next()` helper — need a one-liner that maps to our pagination helper.
Harper: will change pagination to use `for await (const page of client.models.listPages())` in TS, `for page := range client.Models.ListPages(ctx)` in Go, and `for page in client.models.list_pages()` in Python. small boilerplate lines only.
Tom: ping me when you update the Go snippet. I'll run `go vet` and a quick compile of the snippet to catch import gaps.
Harper: plan: update examples, run snippet tests in CI, and then squash + rebase. target to merge by EOD tomorrow.
Nina: small editorial ask — add a short migration note at the top: "If you were using SDK v2 streaming, follow these steps to upgrade" and include a table of changed function names.
Harper: yep adding a short migration checklist. also fixing a broken internal link in the retries doc (old anchor `#retries-v2`).
docs-bot: CI check queued for PR #4591 — snippet-runner will validate python/ts/go examples.
Rajat: FYI — if snippet-runner fails for Go due to missing module, add a tiny `go.mod` snippet in the docs that the runner can use.
Maya: also can we add one sentence about cost/latency tradeoff when turning on aggressive retries? product wants us to be explicit.
Harper: adding a one-paragraph note under the retries section.
Tom: updated PR comment: left nit about using `context.WithTimeout` vs `context.WithCancel` in the example. prefer timeout for simple docs.
Harper: switched to `WithTimeout` in the Go snippet. pushed.
Nina: LGTM pending CI. small grammar fix in the python snippet: "an iterator that yields tokens" -> "an iterator that yields token chunks".
Harper: fixed grammar + pushed.
docs-bot: CI passed for snippet-runner (py/ts) — go tests pending.
Tom: go snippet compiled locally, all good. pushed minor import tidy.
Harper: thanks everyone. will merge once go CI completes and then we'll backport the small link fix to the stable branch. leaving the thread open for any last minute asks. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks! can you also drop a short note in the release notes channel when merged so customer docs sync can pick it up?
Harper: will do.`
